title: The Forgotten Workshop
opening_narrative: You wake up on a dusty bench, with no memory of how you arrived. Your stomach aches with hunger. Around you are a warped wooden cabinet, a closed lunch tin, a brittle wooden mallet, and a sturdy door.

body.description: A hungry but mobile body with hands, able to carry one inventory unit.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.description: A shuttered workshop smells of sawdust. A warped wooden cabinet, a closed lunch tin, a brittle wooden mallet, and a sturdy door stand nearby.

passage.name: Covered passage
passage.description: You step into a narrow covered passage. The workshop door is behind you. A wooden gate stands ahead, and cool air slips between its slats.

garden.name: Garden
garden.description: You emerge into a quiet garden. Birds sing above the damp earth. You are finally clear of the building.

workshop-door.name: Workshop door
workshop-door.description: A thick wooden door with an iron handle.

door-lock.name: Door lock
door-lock.description: A small iron lock set into the workshop door.

garden-gate.name: Wooden gate
garden-gate.description: A waist-high wooden gate with a simple, unlocked latch.

cabinet.name: Wooden cabinet
cabinet.description: A tall cabinet whose wooden door is warped and tightly wedged.
cabinet.broken_description: The cabinet's door has shattered. Its shelf and contents are exposed.

workshop-key.name: Iron key
workshop-key.description: A small iron key with a square bow.

lunch-tin.name: Lunch tin
lunch-tin.description: A broad metal lunch tin with an ordinary hinged lid.

bread.name: Bread roll
bread.description: A wrapped bread roll. It looks edible.

mallet.name: Wooden mallet
mallet.description: A light wooden mallet. Its dry, thin handle looks fragile.
mallet.broken_description: The mallet's handle has split. It can no longer be used as a tool.

shards.name: Wooden shards
shards.description: Small shards from the mallet's split handle.

food.description: Eat a carried food item to recover hunger.

sleep.description: Rest where you are to recover tiredness.
